The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Thursday, March 14, 1935
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 6887
Date 1 / 1 / 35

Shanghai Motorists
Arrested In Chekiang
For Death Of Woman

Mr. G. M. Babbitt and Mr.
K. C. Chow of the China
Highways magazine are be-
ing held in Tung-wan, Che-
kiang province, for the death
of an old woman in a motor
accident at Chow-wu, accord-
ing to a telegram received by
Mr. Carl Crow this morning.
The pair left here last
Friday to explore the new
roads which the province is
building in the interest of
progress and the develop-
ment of tourist traffic.
Mr. Crow has been advised
that officials of the Standard
Oil Company at Yu-yao are
proceeding to Tung-wan, 25
miles south of Shanghing, to
negotiate a settlement with
the local authorities.

SI
J.W.S.
A.G.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
编号 D 6887
日期 1935年1月1日

上海驾车者
在浙江被捕
涉一妇女死亡案

据卡尔·克劳（Carl Crow）先生今晨收到的一份电报称，《中国公路》杂志的 G. M. 巴比特（G. M. Babbitt）先生和 K. C. 周（K. C. Chow）先生因在曹吴（Chow-wu，音译）发生的一起机动车事故中导致一名老妇人死亡，现被羁押于浙江省东湾（Tung-wan，音译）。
二人于上周五离开此地，去考察该省为促进进步和发展旅游交通而修建的新道路。
有人告知克劳先生，余姚的标准石油公司官员正前往位于上兴（Shanghing，音译）以南25英里的东湾（Tung-wan，音译），以便与当地当局协商和解事宜。

SI
J.W.S.
A.G.
